verdict: NEGATIVE for subsolar. The algebra is exact and kernels are ~31x smaller than stored analytic chunks, but memory was never the binding constraint (bank_dense.py already went template-major to work around it) -- compute time is, and ratio filtering does not reduce it. The gain scales as log N / log K, and subsolar's enormous phase accumulation forces K ~ 16,385 taps instead of the paper's ~250, which is exactly why the published 8x does not transfer.
